description: Relationships the architecture model must never contain, explicit or implied. Each rule restates an invariant recorded in the decisions it cites; the decision is the authority, this file is only what tools/docs/check.py reads. A rule whose elements are not yet in the model is reported as inactive.

rules.reason: The control plane never handles bulk data and holds no storage credentials or secret values; whatever touches customer data or credentials runs in the data plane.
The control plane never calls a backend's API directly; the pull-based agent does, in every deployment.
A unit talks only to its local agent; the agent is the single point at which data-plane traffic leaves the customer environment.
Agents reach the control plane only through its agent gateway; the database belongs to the control plane alone.
Clients reach platform state only through the API, which authorises every method.
